title: Software Engineer, I
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
Designs, develops, analyzes, and maintains software solutions for the organization’s products and systems. Performs system integration of software and hardware to ensure throughput, consistency, and compliance with quality standards. Develops, validates, and tests software functionality and associated documentation. Work is reviewed for overall adequacy but allows for greater independence in day-to-day responsibilities. Follows established processes and contributes to improving existing methodologies.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Designs, develops, and tests software components as part of a larger project, ensuring alignment with project objectives and timelines.
* Creates and maintains documentation detailing specific software functionality and design specifications.
* Participates in code reviews and provides constructive feedback.
* Contributes to the development and testing of software solutions for various products analyzes results, and conducts root cause analysis to diagnose and resolve issues.
* Recommends and implements solutions to complex technical challenges, ensuring compliance with quality processes and standards.
* Modifies and enhances existing software, improving functionality, scalability, and performance to meet evolving business needs.
* Proactively seeks out opportunities to enhance performance and productivity by recommending new tools or methodologies.
* Demonstrates sound judgment to determine appropriate actions for software development and testing tasks.
* Assist less experienced staff with existing practices and processes.
* Builds productive working relationships within the team, across organizational units and with external customers.
* Occasionally interacts with inter-organizational and external stakeholders to address project-related needs or resolve issues.

**Job Requirements**
B.Tech/B.E. in
**Computer Science**
or related engineering discipline. 0-1 years of relevant experience.
  
  
**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in data structures, algorithms, system design, and writing clean, maintainable, and highly optimized code across software development frameworks.
* Good interest in and exposure to modern Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and intelligent system architectures through projects, internships, or professional experience
* Good understanding of cloud-based architectures like GCP, containerized environments, CI/CD.
* Knowledge of both backend and modern front-end application interfaces.
* Practical understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC), including Agile/Scrum methodologies, version control systems, debugging, and comprehensive system testing
* Proactive, self-motivated, and eager with strong communication and collaboration skills.

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**
To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
  
  
**AI Technology Statement**
Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

* Experience implementing state management and data-fetching patterns, using Context API and modern state libraries ( e.g. , Redux Toolkit/ Zustand / Recoil ) based on application complexity.

* Strong testing and debugging skills with unit/component testing (Jest, React Testing Library) and end-to-end testing (Cypress/Playwright), ensuring stability and maintainability.
* Experience with React performance optimization, including code splitting, lazy loading, memoization strategies, and efficient rendering of large data sets
* Familiarity with React build tooling, including modern bundlers (Webpack/Vite), environment configuration, and deployment optimization.
* Soft Skills
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven experience working directly with clients and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage expectations, and reduce ambiguity.
* Ability to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and drive clarity in complex or evolving problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration mindset; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams including product managers, designers, QA, and platform teams.
* Ownership-driven approach with the ability to independently drive tasks to completion with minimal handholding

We do that by offering smart software, payments, and commerce-enabling solutions across five “everyday life” verticals: Education, Health and Fitness, Boutique Wellness, Field Services and Personal Services.

You’ll join Xplor Field Services — the team that builds innovative and intuitive solutions for businesses like lawn care, cleaning, snow removal, and more. We help owners streamline scheduling, dispatching, and billing, and with powerful automation, they save time, grow profits, and deliver a smoother experience to their customers.

Our core values - Make Life Simple, Build for People, Move with Purpose, and Create Lasting Communities are key to who we are and what guides us from how we hire to how we recognize our team members.

**Job Description**

Job Description

You’ll join Xplor Field Services and our Global Technology team — You’ll help us enhance our industry-leading platform used by our customer base to run their businesses. Some of the other responsibilities you’ll have:

* Design, develop, and test software applications using .NET Framework, .NET Core, C# and Microsoft.
* Work to extend, troubleshoot and optimize existing framework for stability, scalability and improved member experience.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in existing software applications.
* Stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies, and apply that knowledge to improve our software development processes and tools.
* Collaborate with the team to identify and prioritize technical debt and implement solutions to address it.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including QA, DevOps, and Product Management, to deliver software solutions that meet customer needs
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in existing software applications
* Optimize and improve existing software systems for performance, scalability, and reliability.

**Qualifications**

Qualifications

* 4-8 years' experience in delivering software platforms used across multiple products.
* Experience in software development with .NET Framework, .NET Core, C#, and Microsoft SQL.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and software design patterns.
* Strong understanding of SQL server and the ability to write stored procedures.
* Strong understanding of software design patterns and principles.
* Strong experience in building Rest/JSON based Web Services in .NET.
* Experience with version control systems such as Git.

**Additional Information**

.

We are the first global platform combining SaaS with embedded payments and tools to help businesses grow and succeed. We offer software solutions in fast-growing “everyday life” verticals: Education, Fitness & Wellbeing, Field Services and Personal Services – and a global, cloud-based payment processing platform. With operations in North America, Australasia, Asia, Europe, and the UK, we serve over 106,000 customers that processed over $38 billion in payments across 20 markets in 2024.

This role offers unparalleled growth opportunities within a dynamic team, providing global exposure and the chance to make a tangible impact.
  
  
**The Team: Markets Operations Business Intelligence (BI)**
The Markets Operations Business Intelligence (BI) team is at the forefront of this transformation. We partner with various Operations teams to deliver critical insights into the health of our operational processes. Utilizing a data-driven approach, we identify areas for improvement and ensure that our investments are strategically targeted to achieve maximum efficiency and impact across our global operations.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an inquisitive and curious Business Intelligence Sr Analyst (AVP level) to join our Markets Operations BI team in Pune. This role offers a unique opportunity to directly influence the future of Citi's Markets Operations by implementing innovative data analytics and dashboarding solutions. You will empower our Operations teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of their processes, identify friction points, mitigate risks, and enhance client service. While strong BI skills are essential, success in this role hinges on a deep, proactive engagement with business processes. We are looking for an individual who is driven to ask critical questions, challenge existing methods, and relentlessly pursue inefficiencies, rather than passively waiting for problems to be presented.

Leverage data to substantiate and support evaluations and recommendations for process health improvements.

* Minimum 5-8 years of experience in data science, data analytics role preferably in financial services or capital markets domain

A genuine drive to deeply understand underlying business functions, friction points, and risks by asking challenging questions (e.g., "why is this process necessary?", "what value does this step add?"). A natural aversion to inefficiency and a passion for finding logical, streamlined solutions.

title: FinCrime Data Analyst Lead
description:
Join us as a FinCrime Agile Data Analyst - VP at Barclays, where you will act as the Data Analytics Lead for Financial Crime Agile Testing. You will oversee data analytics work performed within the Agile Testing team and define the analytical testing approach for individual reviews. Working in partnership with Agile Testing colleagues, you will translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, provide input to review scope, and determine data requirements and analytical design. You will quality-control analytical scripts and outputs, communicate data-led findings and observations to stakeholders, and act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts. Through independent judgement, technical assurance and constructive challenge, you will help deliver timely, risk-based and hypothesis-led testing of Financial Crime processes and controls.
  
  
Purpose of the Role
  
  
To oversee and lead the data analytics work supporting Financial Crime Agile Testing reviews. The role determines the overall data analytics approach, defines executable analytical objectives, hypotheses and testing plans for individual reviews, provides quality control over analytical scripts and outputs, and translates data into testable insight that supports assessment of the operational effectiveness of Financial Crime controls.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
  

* Oversee data analytics work performed within the Financial Crime Agile Testing team, including defining the data analytics testing strategy required for individual reviews.
* Translate review triggers into executable objectives, hypotheses and data analytics testing plans, providing data-led input to scoping decisions in collaboration with non-Data Analytics review colleagues.
* Provide leadership and technical oversight for the development of analytical test objectives, methodologies and scripts using SQL, Python and SAS; review and approve analytical work to support robust and reproducible testing outcomes.
* Identify and agree data needs and analytical design with the Agile Testing Lead during review planning and test-plan development.
* Coordinate delivery of analytics with the Agile Testing Lead during testing execution, while Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts design scripts, source data and perform analysis.
* Perform quality-control reviews of analytical scripts, including SQL, SAS and Python, designed by Data Analytics Specialists and/or Data Analytics Analysts, challenging logic, assumptions, data quality, caveats and the sufficiency of analytical evidence.
* Review analytical outputs and workpaper content to support clear, accurate and reproducible documentation of the testing performed, evidence obtained and conclusions supported by the analysis.
* Interpret and communicate findings and observations arising from data analytics testing to external stakeholders and provide analytical insight and draft input to review conclusions and reporting.
* Act as the escalation route for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, addressing analytical judgement matters within authority and escalating material risk, scope, timeline or stakeholder issues where appropriate.
* Work alongside the Agile Testing Lead as part of stage-gate oversight and peer cross-review, preserving independent challenge and clear accountability between Testing and Data Analytics roles.
* Support the ongoing review and improvement of data analytics requirements within the Agile Testing methodology and contribute to efficient, risk-based and hypothesis-led review delivery.
* Maintain independence and objectivity, ensure timely escalation, secure evidence retention, data-privacy compliance and high-quality documentation across data analytics work.

Stakeholder Management and Leadership
  
  
The role requires strong engagement across business teams and larger FinCrime Agile testing team. The VP determines the overall data analytics approach and analytical scoping decisions for individual reviews. The role exercises independent judgement when setting analytical hypotheses and approaches, reviews work completed by Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts, and acts as their escalation route. The role also contributes to the strategic development of the Financial Crime Agile Testing analytics capability and adoption of improved tools and techniques
  
  
**Basic / Essential Qualifications**

* Strong experience leading data analytics work in Financial Crime, Compliance, Risk, Audit, Assurance or another control-testing environment.
* Strong SQL and Python capability, including the ability to review and challenge analytical scripts, logic, assumptions and outputs developed by others.
* Experience translating risk or review triggers into analytical objectives, hypotheses, testing plans, data requirements and executable analytical approaches.
* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes, risks and controls across relevant domains such as AML, Sanctions, Customer Due Diligence/KYC, Fraud or Transaction Monitoring.
* Experience applying data analytics to assess control effectiveness using full-population or targeted testing approaches.
* Strong technical assurance, critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify data-quality issues, anomalies, control weaknesses, caveats and limitations.
* Experience reviewing analytical evidence and workpapers to determine whether testing outputs sufficiently support observations and conclusions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, collaboration and constructive-challenge skills, with the ability to exercise independent judgement and escalate appropriately.
* Ability to coordinate analytical delivery, provide technical guidance and act as an escalation point for Data Analytics Specialists and Analysts.

Desirable Skillsets
  
  
  

* Experience contributing to Financial Crime assurance or Agile Testing methodology and improving analytical testing standards or ways of working.
* Experience with SAS, data visualisation tools such as Tableau, statistical analysis, data mining or AI-enabled analytics.
* Experience developing reusable analytical assets or automated testing approaches that improve testing efficiency, consistency or coverage.
* Knowledge of advanced statistical or machine-learning techniques used to identify patterns, trends and relationships in data.
* Working knowledge of AWS cloud services, LLM architectures, including responsible AI principles and appropriate solution validation.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, including technical assurance, critical thinking, Financial Crime risk and control analysis, root-cause analysis, systems proficiency, stakeholder engagement, collaboration and data analytics using SQL and Python, as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
Role is based out of Pune.

To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.

This role is also responsible for managing and optimizing DealerOn's advertising technology ecosystem, with a focus on Fluency platform administration, Google Analytics implementation, reporting governance, and performance measurement. ****Advertising Technology & Platform Management****

* Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for the Fluency platform across advertising accounts including platform data structures, exports, and reporting outputs.

* Develop standardized templates, workflows, and operating procedures to ensure consistency and scalability.
* Create and maintain documentation, training materials, and implementation guides for internal teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve platform utilization, automation, and operational efficiency.

****Analytics, Measurement, and Reconciliation****

* Partner in owning Google Analytics 4 (GA4) implementation, governance, and ongoing optimization.
* Manage event tracking, conversion tracking, attribution frameworks, and data validation processes.
* Partner with stakeholders to troubleshoot tracking discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.
* Establish measurement standards and best practices across advertising programs.
* Support advanced reporting initiatives that demonstrate advertising performance and return on investment.
* Reconcile spend and performance data across systems, including Monthly Spend Reports, OEM billing files, Fluency platform data, and Salesforce campaign records.
* Isolate dealer-level and channel-level variances and determine whether the cause sits with the provider feed, the platform, or internal configuration.
* Document findings in root cause analyses (RCAs) and defect lists that hold up in provider and OEM escalations.

****Reporting & Business Insights****

* Develop and maintain internal reporting frameworks that support customer-facing deliverables.
* Build dashboards and executive-level reports using analytics and business intelligence tools.
* Analyze campaign performance data and identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities.
* Deliver actionable insights that support customer retention, growth initiatives, and strategic decision-making.
* Collaborate with the DigAd OEM team and customer-facing stakeholders to translate performance data into meaningful business recommendations.
* Build repeatable analysis templates and documented methodologies so recurring OEM data requests can be completed faster with consistent output.

****Quality Assurance & Governance****

* Conduct regular audits of Fluency configurations, analytics implementations, and reporting accuracy.
* Ensure compliance with established operational standards and best practices.
* Identify and resolve operational issues impacting campaign performance, measurement, or reporting.
* Perform pre-submission quality assurance on OEM billing files and monthly spend reports ahead of program deadlines.

****Cross-Functional Collaboration****

* Partner with the DigAd OEM team, the Partners and Platforms team, Advertising Strategy, Product, Analytics, Customer Success, and Operations teams to support advertising initiatives.

* Collaborate with leadership to identify opportunities for process improvements and operational enhancements.

****Innovation & Continuous Improvement****

* Stay informed on industry trends, analytics advancements, advertising technologies, and platform updates.
* Evaluate new tools, integrations, and reporting capabilities that improve advertising performance.
* Support testing and validation of new platform features, products, and operational processes.
* Recommend scalable solutions that enhance efficiency, reporting quality, and customer outcomes.
* Identify recurring data issues and recommend systemic fixes rather than one-time corrections.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams through expertise and collaboration.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly in writing for internal and provider-facing documentation.
* Sound judgment on when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate, including the ability to challenge data that appears incorrect.
* Working knowledge of OEM program structures, tier definitions, and billing mechanics.

**Qualifications**
****Required****

At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
The AI Solutions Engineer is the hands-on builder of the AI Hub Center of Excellence. Where the AI Engineering & Enablement Lead sets architecture and governance, this role turns that direction into working, production-grade agents and AI workflows that ride on EVERSANA's enterprise AI stack (GCP, Vertex AI, Claude, Gemini Enterprise).
  
  
This engineer productionizes enterprise AI tooling for Patient Services use cases, builds the reusable patterns other teams depend on, and integrates AI into the Salesforce, MuleSoft, and Java touchpoints of our SDLC. It is a deep technical role for someone who wants to build real AI systems in a regulated healthcare environment, not just experiment.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
**Agent & Workflow Development**

* Design and build AI agents on Vertex AI Agent Builder, the Claude API, and Gemini Enterprise.
* Productionize enterprise AI tooling for priority Patient Services use cases: intake automation, missing-information workflow, adverse-event detection, workload queue intelligence, QNCR automation, and chat-with-claims.
* Build and maintain RAG pipelines, vector stores, embeddings, and retrieval workflows against Patient Services data.
* Implement MCP server integrations and agent tool/function definitions that expose enterprise systems to agents safely.

**Integration & SDLC**

* Integrate AI capabilities into Salesforce Health Cloud (Apex, LWC), MuleSoft (DataWeave), and Java SDLC touchpoints.
* Build reusable prompt templates and agent patterns that the broader engineering team can adopt.
* Contribute to the shared prompt/pattern library with quality-reviewed, version-controlled components.

**Lifecycle & Quality**

* Own the agent lifecycle end to end: build, deploy, monitor, evaluate, and retire.
* Establish evaluation harnesses so agents are tested against defined quality bars before production.
* Review AI-generated code produced by Salesforce, MuleSoft, and Java developers, ensuring it meets ACTICS quality standards.
* Monitor deployed agents for drift, cost, latency, and accuracy; remediate as needed.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* 5+ years in software engineering, with hands-on experience building production systems.
* Advanced Python; competence in JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Direct experience with a cloud AI platform (Vertex AI strongly preferred) and its SDK.
* Demonstrated prompt engineering and LLM application development with Claude, Gemini, or equivalent models.
* Practical experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval design.
* Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph, or Vertex Agent Builder).
* Experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs; Salesforce and/or MuleSoft integration experience a strong plus.
* Comfortable working on a follow-the-sun model with an onshore lead.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and agent tooling standards.
* Background in healthcare or life-sciences technology; awareness of PHI/HIPAA constraints.
* Salesforce (Apex/LWC) or Java development experience.
* Experience with BigQuery, PostgreSQL, or comparable data platforms.

**Tools & Stack**

* AI: Vertex AI Agent Builder, Claude API, Gemini Enterprise API.
* Orchestration: CrewAI, LangChain, LangGraph.
* Dev productivity: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot.
* Data & cloud: GCP, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, vector stores.

**First-Year Success Measures**

* Intake Automation MVP and at least two additional AI workflow MVPs built and shipped to one or more programs.
* Reusable agent patterns and prompt library established and adopted by other engineers.
* Agent evaluation and monitoring practices operational for every production agent.

**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded**
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
  
  
**Client Delight**
I own every client experience and its impact on results.

I am empowered and empower others to act now.
  
  
**Grow Talent**
I own my development and invest in the development of others.
  
  
**Win Together**
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
  
  
**Communication Matters**
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
  
  
**Embrace Diversity**
I create an environment of awareness and respect.
  
  
**Always Innovate**
I am bold and creative in everything I do.

* Fine-tune and deploy open-source large language models (LLMs) and private models for EdTech applications.
* Implement **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** systems combining retrieval with generative models.
* Leverage **LangGraph** and **LangChain** for orchestration, multi-step workflows, and stateful agent design.

  

* **Data Engineering & Integration:**
* Develop and integrate **real-time data pipelines** and event-driven architectures using **Kafka, Spark, or PySpark**.
* Build secure, scalable, and cloud-native AI solutions using **AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Azure ML (AML), Azure AKS**, and related services.
* Implement **MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for efficient deployment, monitoring, and scaling of AI models.

  

* **AI Infrastructure & Tools:**

* Develop prompt engineering strategies and optimize LLMs for improved accuracy and relevance.
* Contribute to internal AI frameworks and toolkits for accelerated adoption across teams.

  

* **Leadership:**
* Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering innovation and skill development.

* Promote best practices in coding, testing, documentation, and model lifecycle management.

  

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
* 3+ years in AI/ML system development and deployment in production environments.
* Proven track record of designing AI systems in **cloud environments** and working with **data-intensive pipelines**.

  

* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong Python proficiency (async programming, multi-step workflows).
* Expertise in machine learning and deep learning frameworks: **TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn**.
* Proficiency with tools like **Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI API, and Bedrock API**.
* Hands-on experience with **ETL/ELT workflows**, data transformations, and **SQL (data modeling, normalization, optimization)**.
* Knowledge of **RAG architectures, Graph Databases, and MCP (Model Context Protocol)**.
* Familiarity with **CI/CD pipelines**, containerization (**Docker, Kubernetes**), and cloud AI platforms (**AWS, GCP, Azure**).

  

* **Domain Knowledge:**
* Understanding of **EdTech standards** like **LTI, xAPI, QTI**, and SCORM.
* Familiarity with **adaptive learning systems** and educational content pipelines.
* Knowledge of workflows in K-12, higher education, and corporate learning environments is a strong plus.

  

* **Soft Skills:**
* Exceptional leadership and team mentoring abilities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and excellent communication for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Education:**
* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related fields.

  

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to lead AI initiatives that shape the future of education technology.
* Work in a collaborative, mission-driven environment with a focus on innovation.
* Engage with impactful projects and cutting-edge AI technologies.

title: Lead Full Stack Developer (.NET & Angular)
description:
Lead Full Stack Developer — AI-Forward Development (.NET & Angular)

Saisystems Health is hiring a Lead Full Stack Developer with 9+ years of .NET and Angular experience, a US healthcare background and a track record of AI-forward engineering to lead technical delivery on ECM, our enterprise claims management platform.

About the role

The Lead owns technical direction and delivery quality for an ECM squad: setting architecture and coding standards, reviewing critical changes, mentoring developers, and still shipping hands-on code across Angular, .NET and T-SQL. Roughly half the role is hands-on engineering; the rest is design, review, planning and people leadership.

**The product.**
ECM manages the full claim lifecycle for US healthcare provider organisations: patient and encounter capture, coding and charge entry, eligibility, a configurable business-rules engine, clearinghouse claim transmission, ERA/835 payment posting, denial and AR work queues, patient statements, credentialing and executive reporting.

**The engineering problem.**
ECM is a mature, high-volume, multi-tenant SaaS platform with tens of millions of claim and transaction rows, external BI consumers on the same database, and scheduled automation alongside the API. The Lead decides how new features and modernisation — performance, observability, test coverage, security hardening and debt reduction — are sequenced in a system that cannot stop running.

**Why AI-forward.**
The Lead sets how the team uses AI: which tools and workflows are approved, how AI-assisted code is reviewed, and where AI measurably improves throughput and quality — while keeping PHI and secrets out of external tools.

Key responsibilities

Technical leadership and architecture

* Own the technical design of features and modernisation work across Angular, ASP.NET Core and Azure SQL; write design notes and lead design reviews.
* Define and enforce coding standards, layering (controller → interface → service → stored procedure), API contracts and Angular/NgRx patterns.
* Lead decomposition of oversized services and components, and plan incremental refactoring without disrupting production.
* Drive database performance: indexing strategy, execution-plan analysis, Query Store regressions and locking against concurrent BI reads.
* Shape the architecture of healthcare integrations — X12 EDI (837, 835, 277CA, 999), clearinghouse SFTP, ERA auto-posting and payer interfaces.

AI-forward engineering leadership

* Set the team's AI development practice: approved tools, prompting and context-management techniques, and agentic workflows for multi-file changes, test generation and migration.
* Define review standards for AI-assisted code, with added scrutiny for stored procedures, EDI processing and production data paths.
* Identify, prototype and measure AI use cases in the workflow and the product (for example, test-case design, code review assistance, denial analysis or document extraction) within approved, HIPAA-compliant tooling.
* Coach developers on effective, verified AI use and share reusable prompts and playbooks across teams.

Delivery and quality

* Break down epics into estimable work with the Development Manager and product owners; own sprint technical commitments.
* Review pull requests on critical paths and run pre-merge impact assessment across develop → QA → UAT → staging → production.
* Raise unit and integration test coverage (xUnit, Moq, Jasmine/Karma) and partner with QA on regression strategy.
* Lead diagnosis of production incidents using Application Insights, logs and Query Store; run root-cause reviews and track fixes.
* Maintain a prioritised technical-debt backlog and balance it against feature delivery.

People and collaboration

* Mentor and grow developers through pairing, code review and design feedback; contribute to hiring and onboarding.
* Act as the technical point of contact for US-based product and business stakeholders, translating requirements into clear designs and realistic estimates.
* Communicate status, risks and trade-offs clearly in writing for asynchronous, cross-time-zone work.

Security and compliance

* Ensure HIPAA and secure-by-default practices are designed in: minimum-necessary data access, audit logging, secrets in Key Vault, least-privilege access and no PHI in logs, tickets or AI tools.
* Review designs for audit, access-control and data-retention requirements.

Required qualifications

Experience

* 9+ years of professional software development, with deep full stack experience in .NET and Angular on production systems.
* 3+ years in a technical lead, tech lead or senior-lead role — owning design, code review and delivery for a team of developers.
* 3+ years working on US healthcare software — revenue cycle management, medical billing, claims, practice management, EHR or payer systems.

.NET, database and architecture

* Expert C# and ASP.NET Core Web API (.NET 6 or later), with EF Core and/or Dapper; strong grasp of layered architecture, SOLID and dependency injection.
* Advanced SQL Server / T-SQL: designing schemas and indexes, tuning complex stored procedures, reading execution plans and resolving locking and blocking at scale.
* Proven experience refactoring and modernising a large, live codebase incrementally.

Angular

* Expert Angular (12+) with TypeScript, RxJS and NgRx or another Redux-style store; able to set front-end architecture and standards for a team.

AI-forward engineering

Healthcare domain

Leadership and practice

* Clear written and verbal communication with US-based stakeholders.
* Willing to work from the Pune office full time.

Preferred qualifications

* Experience integrating LLM APIs (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenAI) into .NET applications — prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured output, evaluation and cost control — within HIPAA-compliant boundaries.
* Experience shipping AI features in RCM, such as denial prediction, coding assistance, document extraction or claim scrubbing.
* Deep Microsoft Azure experience: App Service, WebJobs, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Service Bus, Redis, Application Insights, Entra ID; infrastructure-as-code (Bicep or Terraform).

* EDI tooling such as EdiFabric; clearinghouse onboarding and payer connectivity.
* Observability practice: structured logging (Serilog), distributed tracing, SLOs and alerting.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field — or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. What you have built, shipped and led counts more than the credential.
